written_before: the clean load runs (load_default.json with --reset-services), the control, recovery, UI and startup runs
status: Proposed by the benchmark author for the prototype; not a certified safety requirement. The report owner may replace them; results are reported against these values only.

S17_load_level_meets_requirements_if_all.rule: a node count passes only if all 3 independent runs pass

control_cases: each step must match the expected output written in scripts/bench/control_cases.py before the run

recovery_cases.R01_influx_sink_stop: no reading lost in InfluxDB after catch-up
recovery_cases.R03_kafka_stop: report loss; no acceptance value set (Kafka is the single durable store)
recovery_cases.R02_R04: report loss and reconnect time; no acceptance value set
recovery_cases.R05_malformed: every malformed message in the DLQ and the next valid message delivered
recovery_cases.R06_inference_stop: AiotEdgeInferenceStale pending within 30 s of the stop
recovery_cases.R07_ui_grafana_prometheus_stop: readings stored and control commands still issued during the outage
